text:
anya: Quick heads-up — regressing on our MVP economics. Two enterprise pilots added streaming + rerank use cases; we’re above the cost envelope and risk missing the launch window. can we triage cuts today?

matt: Thanks. Can you drop the delta numbers? p50 latency and incremental $/1k tokens?

anya: p50 for chat up from 180ms -> 270ms under pilot load. incremental cost ~+35% at current batching.

claire: That's expected with reranker in the loop. Options: 1) remove reranker from MVP, 2) reduce max tokens / reply size, 3) use smaller model variant for rerank.

ravi: From UX — reranker improves relevance a bunch for these pilots. Removing it will degrade first-time impressions. Can we do a soft fallback instead?

sanju: Soft fallback = route to cheaper model variant when capacity or latency > threshold. That keeps UX in normal cases. Implementation risk: routing + monitoring + canary ~3 days.

matt: Launch criteria reminder: must hit p50 < 220ms and cost delta <= 20% vs baseline. If we can't meet both, we need a cut list.

anya: Proposal: cut 2 items for MVP, keep in v1. Candidates: A) reranker for non-critical flows, B) streaming typing indicator, C) long history context beyond 2k tokens.

claire: Engineering estimate: A = 3d, B = 1d, C = 2d infra + 2d work. A has highest implementation time but largest perf win.

ravi: If we remove streaming (B) it hurts discoverability less than removing reranker — but it’s a visible regression.

matt: Tradeoff matrix: short-term risk vs long-term value. We should prioritize customer pilots that triggered expansion. Which customers care about reranker?

anya: Pilot A (healthcare) needs rerank. Pilot B (finance) OK without rerank. If we cut rerank, we lose healthcare traction.

sanju: Alternative: enable rerank only for Pilot A in a dedicated route on Dedicated capacity — keeps hosted cost down but adds infra complexity and a support requirement. Estimate 4d SRE + infra config.

matt: That’s interesting — carveout for Pilot A buys launch safety. Cost to us vs revenue? Ask sales for a short-term commit.

anya: I’ll ping sales after this thread. If sales can confirm a short-term commit, we can do the Dedicated carveout. Otherwise: cut rerank from MVP, ship streaming, keep history trimmed to 2k.

claire: Agreed. If we cut rerank from MVP, we should add an explicit v1 ticket to re-enable with quantization/smaller model variant.

release-bot: deploy window update: next ship window moves up 2 days if scope cut confirmed by EOD.

matt: Action items: 1) anya -> confirm sales commit by 17:00 PT, 2) claire -> block off 1 engineer for Dedicated carveout estimate, 3) sanju -> draft routing/canary checklist. If no commit, implement rerank cut plan and update launch notes.

anya: copying sales now. will update here. :thumbsup:

ravi: Also flag design for rollback messaging if streaming removed. small copy changes will help perception.

matt: Thanks all — synchronous check at 16:00 if needed.
